title: Evaluating Step-by-step Reasoning Traces: A Survey
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2025
best_for_zh: 关于思维链、过程标签与推理轨迹评测准则的综述。
one_line: A survey that turns “is this chain of thought good?” into four auditable evaluation dimensions.
将“推理链是否好”拆为事实性、有效性、连贯性与效用四个可审计维度的综述。
why: It prevents a correct final answer from being mistaken for a validated reasoning trace.
inclusion_reason: The clearest Track0 primer for separating outcome evaluation from factuality, validity, coherence, and utility of reasoning traces.

title: Problem
问题
html: Step-by-step reasoning is widely used, but a correct answer does not show whether its intermediate trace is factual, valid, coherent, or useful. This Findings of EMNLP 2025 survey is available from ACL at https://aclanthology.org/2025.findings-emnlp.94/. It addresses inconsistent trace-evaluation practice by mapping the criteria, datasets, and evaluator implementations. A trace evaluator can make different claims depending on the unit it labels, the reference evidence it can see, and whether its result is aggregated over steps, traces, or answers. Its role is to establish that vocabulary before readers consume process-label or trace datasets.
逐步推理被广泛使用，但最终答案正确不代表中间轨迹事实正确、逻辑有效、连贯或有用。这篇 EMNLP 2025 Findings 综述整理了评测准则、数据集和评估器实现，以解释实践中的不一致。轨迹评估器能够作出何种主张，取决于它标注的单元、可见的参考证据，以及结果是在步骤、整条轨迹还是答案层面聚合。论文由此区分过程标签、推理轨迹和最终答案的不同评测对象。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The paper proposes four top-level criteria: factuality, validity, coherence, and utility. Each criterion asks a different question: whether statements are supported, whether reasoning follows, whether the explanation hangs together, and whether it serves a task or reader. Each therefore needs a different data or evaluator contract, so no single outcome score can stand in for all of them. The taxonomy connects trace datasets, evaluator implementations, and evaluation findings without claiming they are interchangeable or that final-answer accuracy validates intermediate reasoning.
论文提出四类顶层准则：事实性、有效性、连贯性和效用。它们分别问：陈述是否有证据支撑、推理是否成立、解释是否前后一致、以及它是否服务于任务或读者。每种准则都对应不同的数据或 评估器契约，因此一个 结果 分数不能替代全部。该 分类框架连接轨迹数据集、评估器实现和评测发现，但不把它们视为可互换，也不把最终答案正确率当作中间推理已被验证。

title: Method
方法
html: The survey reviews datasets and evaluators through the four criteria. When documenting a process-evaluation source, retain the trace unit, criterion definition, reference evidence, rater or judge, aggregation method, and relation to final-answer correctness. Record whether labels target individual steps, local transitions, full traces, or comparative preferences: changing that unit changes both the training signal and the validity of a reported metric. Route process labels to Track4, verifier-backed claims to Track5, and benchmark methodology to Track11.
综述按四类准则回顾数据集和 评估器。文档化过程评测来源时，应保留轨迹单元、准则定义、参考证据、标注者或 裁判模型、聚合方式，以及它同最终答案正确性的关系。还应记录标签针对单步、局部转移、整条轨迹还是比较偏好：单元改变会同时改变训练信号与报告指标的有效性。

title: Evidence
证据
html: ACL records the four-category taxonomy and surveys of datasets and evaluator implementations; the proceedings version spans pages 1789–1814. It is a methodology source, not a new trace-label release.
ACL 记录了四类 分类框架及对数据集、评估器实现的综述，会议版本为 1789–1814 页。它是方法学来源，不是新的轨迹标签发布。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Reasoning evaluation existed before this paper; its contribution is a unified criterion-level map that exposes why evaluator and benchmark results can conflict. It combines the criteria with a review of datasets and evaluator implementations, so a reader can see whether a claimed process score answers the question they care about. The key point is that “process quality” has multiple targets, including semantic correctness, logical validity, readability, and task usefulness. It does not validate every reviewed evaluator or supply a universal scorer.
推理评测早于该文；其贡献是统一的准则级地图，解释为何 评估器与 基准结果会冲突。它把这些准则与数据集和 评估器实现的综述结合，使读者能判断某个过程分数是否回答了自己关心的问题。关键点是“过程质量”有多个目标，包括语义正确、逻辑有效、可读性和任务效用；它不验证每个被综述的 评估器，也不提供普适评分器。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Many criteria still require judgment, and the survey cannot guarantee cross-domain agreement among evaluators. A high utility score does not prove factuality or validity.
许多准则仍依赖判断，综述也不能保证 评估器跨领域一致；高效用分不证明事实性或有效性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: The survey distinguishes four targets for reasoning-trace evaluation: factuality, validity, coherence, and utility. It relates these targets to datasets and evaluator implementations, showing why a final-answer score cannot substitute for every claim about intermediate reasoning quality.
综述区分四个推理轨迹评测目标：事实性、有效性、连贯性和效用。它将这些目标与数据集和 评估器实现联系起来，说明最终答案分数不能替代关于中间推理质量的所有主张。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: A reasoning trace is not simply good or bad. Factuality, validity, coherence, and usefulness ask different questions; a correct final answer does not guarantee that its intermediate reasoning succeeds on all four.
一条推理链“看起来好”并不是单一性质。事实性、有效性、连贯性和效用回答的是不同问题；最终答案正确，并不意味着中间过程在这些维度上同样可靠。

引用
